description.value: The Seoulful is a Korean cafe and bakery in Richmond's Number 3 Road corridor, known for Korean-style salted butter breads, kimbap rolls, tteokbokki, and non-coffee lattes. The menu leans heavily on Seoul street-food staples — from bulgogi kimbap to creamy rose tteokbokki — alongside a creative lineup of matcha and fruit lattes. Online ordering for pickup is available, and recent customer reviews highlight the quality of the baked goods as a standout draw.
